issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders: The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares the SealSaloon attribute "totalOrders" as type int (UML line: '-totalOrders: int'), whereas the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java) declares the field as 'private long totalOrders = 0;'. This mismatch between int (spec) and long (solution) may confuse students about the intended type and lead to inconsistencies if tests or student code assume the UML literal type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent. Either change the reference implementation field to 'private int totalOrders = 0;' to match the UML/specification, or update the problem statement UML and any descriptive text to specify 'long' for totalOrders. Prefer fixing the artifact that is easier to change for grading infrastructure (e.g., update the UML to 'long' if the solution and tests expect a long), and document the chosen type in the problem text.
